before.rationale: WordNet requires a ball with a hole; the source-lineage corrected decorative object concept also admits other shapes or attachment. Target is narrower, not pearl.

after.rationale: Arca decorative beads need not be spherical or pierced; WordNet small pierced balls need not be decorative. These crossing criteria establish overlap, not containment. The inherited pearl association is not accepted equivalence.

before.rationale: Connecting two or more pieces; Arca does not require a rope or a knot.

after.rationale: Connecting or fastening pieces is a physical reading within the unrestricted Arca connection-of-things definition; rope and knot are not required by this target.

before.rationale: WordNet explicitly describes a human arm; Arca upper-limb definition does not specify humans exclusively.

after.rationale: WordNet combines technical upper-arm and common whole-limb usages and specifies humans; Arca describes a full upper limb with variable inclusion of the hand. Crossing region/species boundaries do not establish containment.

before.rationale: Biological animal category rather than the adjective carnal.
Medicinal substances include prevention and symptom relief, whereas Arca specifies promotion of healing.

after.rationale: Disease treatment/prevention and any substance promoting healing have crossing scopes: prevention need not promote healing, while healing may concern injuries rather than disease. Overlap alone does not prove containment.

before.rationale: Physical swallowing of food/drink is within the human reflex category; excludes figurative acceptance and expression suppression.

after.rationale: WordNet restricts to eating/drinking but does not specify humans; Arca specifies a human reflex and does not restrict the swallowed object to food/drink. Crossing participant/object restrictions preclude one-direction containment.

qualification: Same-model internal correction, not independent expert adjudication; crossing restrictions must not be summarized as a one-direction containment. These are draft curation corrections, not an estimated corpus error rate.
animal_scope_note: Scientific wording and elicitation scopes (including human exclusion) require separate decisions; no lexical row is deleted or remapped.
